title: Studying harmony and arranging with Benny Goodman
summary: He and Goodman study harmony and arranging for a year and a half, then decide to remain players.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: I read a great deal. Then I got back, well Benny Goodman and I studied for about a year and a half. Paul Harold who's in Chicago, Paul

(Harold?) went to school with Igor Stravinsky in Russia and he studied at Rimski-korsikav's school over there. Studied music see composing symphonies and so forth. So Benny Goodman and I studied for a year and a half there. We used to go, in Chicago. Harmonies and arranging.
But neither one of us cared to continue arranging. It's too confining. You have to sit down and write all the parts.
And you don't make any money either. (LAUGHTER).

Scores. Well I wasn't making any money. But I made a few arrangements for Art Kassel and his orchestra and he paid me for them. But see it was too confining and both he and I decided we'd rather be players than composers or arrangers. But, so I did get a fairly good education.
